'''A'mari''' was a clan who formerly ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Malano III]]. They were distinguished by a black [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] across their neck. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent [[X-7]] infiltrated the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], he pretended to be a member of the clan.
